description: Capture a semantic map of a page for deciding what to act on. Returns {url, title, elements}, where each element is {ref, tag, text} — ref being an @eN handle that session_click, session_fill, session_type, session_select and session_press all accept in place of a CSS selector. Prefer this over session_read_page when the goal is to interact rather than to read: it lists only elements a user could actually operate. Skips zero-size and hidden elements, caps each label at 120 characters, and stops at 200 elements.

tabId.description: Tab to snapshot; uses the active tab when omitted

name: session_snapshot
